claims.text: Wild-type or variant ATTR-CM w NYHA I–III HF: a TTR tetramer stabilizer (tafamidis) = indicated to ↓CV morbidity and mortality.
claims.quote: In select patients with wild-type or variant transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis and NYHA class I to III HF symptoms, transthyretin tetramer stabilizer therapy (tafamidis) is indicated to reduce cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.
